name: Santa Fe de Mondújar (Spain)
description: Five horizontal stripes of turquoise, yellow, green, yellow and turquoise with a broad green middle stripe, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Santa Fe de Mondújar (a bridge and a tree on blue above waves).
history: Santa Fe de Mondújar was authorised by the Junta de Andalucía on 17 December 2004 to adopt its symbols but did not do so until January 2007; the flag is a rectangular cloth of 1:1.5 of five stripes perpendicular to the staff, the first and fifth turquoise blue of a third of the width each, the second and fourth gold yellow of 1/12, with the municipal arms at the centre.

features.role: Santa Fe de Mondújar arms — bridge and tree above waves
